description: This source file defines an Android App Widget named 'BuildWidget' that displays build information such as build ID, date, and fingerprint. It includes an internal service 'UpdateService' that constructs and updates the widget's RemoteViews, handled in response to widget updates.

classes.name: BuildWidget
classes.description: The main AppWidgetProvider class responsible for widget behavior and lifecycle, mainly initiating updates via a background service.

classes.name: BuildWidget.UpdateService
classes.description: A background service that builds and updates the widget's RemoteViews with build information.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Triggered when the widget needs to be updated; starts the UpdateService.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles the service start event, constructs widget updates, and applies them.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Creates and returns the RemoteViews object that represents the widget's UI, populating it with build info.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used in this service.
